verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents a built-in MCP server for AI assistants, connectable via `claude mcp add`. Its tools let an agent browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve, unresolve, or ignore issues, which covers pulling and triaging production errors. Nothing shows GlitchTip filing bugs into an external tracker, so that step needs a separate tool; the GitLab integration only displays GlitchTip errors in GitLab. Missing for 10: native tracker integration for creating bugs, documented ranking or filtering of 'top' issues by frequency or impact, a published REST API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.
